key_findings: Mean-difference emotion vectors on Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B form a circular valence-arousal plane (valence r=0.89 with PC1 at layer 4). Steering along the arousal axis gives monotonic control of refusal: HarmBench refusal falls from 87% to 5% at alpha=+0.45, and XSTest refusal rises from 8% to 86% at alpha=-0.45. Random directions stay within 2 to 3% of baseline. Appendix H: the Arditi et al. refusal direction is nearly orthogonal to the VA plane (86.5 degrees), but its in-plane part has negative valence and negative arousal. The authors explain the effect by 'lexical mediation': refusal and compliance tokens sit in different VA regions.
